ops.title: cc-transcript docs gate is the gd-build wrapper, never bare `great-docs build`; curated reference rejects PEP 695 type aliases
ops.body:
Since the gd-build absorption (v14 era, ~2026-07), cc-transcript's docs gate is `uv sync --group docs` then `uv run --with "git+https://github.com/yasyf/cc-skills@main#subdirectory=tools/gd-build" gd-build build` — the exact docs-CI command, documented at AGENTS.md § Docs. Bare `uv run great-docs build` fails at Step 17 (Quarto render): it skips the pre_render titles script gd-build materializes into the gitignored `docs/scripts/.gd-build/`, and the generated `great-docs/` scratch dir then references a script that was never copied in. Older memories here ([[docs-build-sidebar-cost]], [[great-docs-executable-cells]]) predate the wrapper — their build-command details are stale, their content otherwise stands. Full wrapper build ran ~16m on the M5 Max (2026-07-18).

Also: the curated reference renders via STATIC griffe over `_native.pyi` (dynamic mode permanently off — union aliases trip CyclicAliasError; cc-notes note 4e18bcca), and a PEP 695 `type X = …` alias in the curated `reference:` contents kills Step 15 with "Cannot document object of kind: Kind.TYPE_ALIAS" (proven by A/B with `Fidelity`, 2026-07-18; cc-notes note b9d1f1f6). Never curate `type` statement aliases (`Fidelity`, `Role`, `Preview`).
